steps.note: Join ending: the Citadel an hour later, no 06:00 walkabout. The player pressed the key and Tesseract walked out with them.

said: He said it had to be one of ours. He was right, and I signed for that agent myself.
Find 0x00. Bring them in, and bring them to me.
DR ADRIAN TESSERACT: Walked out with 0x00.
AGENT HAX: Handler. Her last message to 0x00 went unanswered.
